name: content-strategy-generator
description: Turn AdAnt-analyzed trending videos into 5-10 copy-paste-ready content strategies for a product: reads the initial social content research report, excludes past inspiration videos and concept duplicates, adapts source hooks and overlays, and maintains strategy history
author: Adant AI
capabilities: Read the initial social content research report in markdown or PDF
Hard-exclude past inspiration videos (strategy history + user-provided lists) by URL
Concept-similarity filter: authenticated AdAnt compares candidate fingerprints against past strategy concepts
Generate 5-10 strategies: inspiration video, avatar suggestion, adapted script, adapted text overlays, editing instructions
Keep the source hook and viral format - small changes only, product swapped in
Render a markdown report with per-strategy copyable blocks and Adant (adant.ai) paste instructions
Append the batch to the strategy history JSON so the next run never repeats a concept
